get code expiration.description: Displays when to change the lockbox code next.

update code.description: Applies the next lockbox code and displays when to change it next.

set code.description: Updates the lockbox code to the given code.

set code expiration.description: Updates the code change reminder to happen on the given date. Date can be in any parsable format.

list bands.description: Lists the names of the bands recognized.

add band.description: Adds a band with the given name, role, and channel. Sends a greeting message to the band if parameter is not given or is "true".

set band name.description: Updates the name of the band with the given name to the new name.

remove band.description: Removes the band with the given name.

next rehearsal.description: Displays the details of the next rehearsal. Displays all with the same start time.

next request.description: Displays the details of the next gear request that is not a rehearsal. Displays all with the same start time.

refresh calendar.description: Manually updates gear requests from the calendar and reschedules gear request messages.

list greetings.description: Lists the greetings set for each category.

add greeting.description: Adds the given greeting to the given category of greetings. If not given, "general" is the default category.

remove greeting.description: Removes all instances of the greeting from the list of greetings.

list farewells.description: Lists the farewells set for each category.

add farewell.description: Adds the given farewell to the given category of farewells. If not given, "general" is the default category.

remove farewell.description: Removes all instances of the given farewell from the list of farewells.

roll.params: <optional: size of dice> <optional: num of dice>
roll.description: Rolls the given number of dice of the given size. Default is a single d20.

list settings.description: Lists all settings and their current values.

set setting.description: Sets the setting with the given name to the given value.

list commands.description: Lists all commands and their usages.
